veranderings.rede: As written, 'wat op die grond jag' attaches to 'pote', so the legs seem to hunt; the bird must be the subject.

vlae.teks: Die leuse beteken letterlik dat verskillende mense saamkom.
vlae.rede: The protected entry glosses the motto as 'diverse mense verenig', while the lesson says 'verskillende mense saamkom'; 'saamkom' and 'verenig' are not quite the same, and choosing between them is a content decision, so not changed.
